Design System for Disney

Disney Technology

Summary

This case study covers the creation of a Design System for the Disney Technology Suite, unifying design principles across four+ apps.

Challenge

Create consistency across multiple Disney Technology applications without slowing product teams down.

Solution

Defined scalable components, shared principles, and reusable interface patterns for a broader design system.

Impact

Unified design decisions across four or more applications and supported a stronger foundation for future product work.
